messages:
anya: FYI ran a small canary on H100 (2024-11-03) and saw p95 regressions for short sequences
anya: seq <64 p95 +12% vs A100 baseline, overall CPU up, GPU utilization similar
bench-bot: quick summary attached: model=gpt-medium, skewed workload towards short prompts\bench-bot: A100 baseline p50=28ms p95=45ms; H100 canary p50=30ms p95=50ms\anya: routing debug shows CUTLASS being chosen a lot for seqs around 32-48
anya: ```
2024-11-03T10:12:01Z kernel_decider: candidates=[triton, cutlass]
2024-11-03T10:12:01Z score_triton=0.73 score_cutlass=0.76 -> pick=cutlass
2024-11-03T10:12:01Z seq_len=48 hw=H100 mem_policy=fast
```
kevin: small score delta. autotuner probably favored throughput/TFLOPS on H100 but launch overhead kills tiny-latency cases
kevin: H100 mma/fp8 can make CUTLASS win mid/long, but at seq <64 kernel launch + setup beats that\maria: also note KV cache behavior in this canary: higher KV hit rate changed effective runtime pattern (prompt+kv mix) and autotune didn't weight that\sanjay: which scoring mode was active for this canary? static heuristics or online adaptive?
anya: online adaptive scoring was enabled (we flipped adaptive scoring last week for canaries)
kevin: can we repro with forced routes? e.g. KERNEL_FORCE=triton vs =cutlass to A/B latency at seqs 16/32/48
anya: yes starting forced-route run now, will post numbers
maria: short-term mitigation: bias router towards TRITON for seq<64 on H100 with an experiment flag (latency-aware delta)
kevin: suggestion: runtime override json: ```{"routing_overrides": [{"arch": "H100", "seq_len_lt": 64, "score_delta": {"triton": 0.08}}]}```
anya: that would be fast to flip for canaries if bench confirms
deploy-bot: canary 2024-11-03-h100 id=c-442 queued; auto-rollback if p95 degrade >8% for 10m\sanjay: running forced-triton vs forced-cutlass at seqs {16,32,48,128}; 30m ETAs for run+aggregate\sanjay: will include flamegraphs and per-kernel timelines in report
maria: filed AUTOTUNE-321 to add kv-aware sample weighting + latency penalty term, assigned to sanjay/kevin/anya
kevin: if forced-run shows triton wins for small seqs, apply runtime override to canary then schedule full autotune with mixed kv-aware samples
anya: ack, waiting on sanjay's numbers before toggling canary flags :thumbsup:
